Hi Lena —

It was great to meet you at the FinTechX panel yesterday — I appreciated the convo about latency-sensitive scoring use cases. I wanted to follow up with a quick recap and a proposed next step.

Recap:
- You mentioned real-time risk scoring (p50 target ~200ms, concurrent traffic currently ~250 qps)
- Data residency and SOC2 compliance are blockers for production deployments
- You're exploring options for a pilot to validate latency and cost vs. current infra

Next steps I suggest:
1) 30-minute discovery call with your eng + product to confirm traffic profile and data flows
2) A short demo of our Dedicated/Private options and a pilot proposal
3) Fast follow-up with a pricing estimate and SOC2 evidence

I've attached a one-pager (Redwood-Platform-Overview.pdf) that highlights our hosting modes and observability features. Would you be available for a quick call next week? I have Tue/Wed morning PST open — happy to work around your schedule.

Thanks again for connecting at the event — I think there's a good fit on the latency/cost front.

Best,

Subject: Post-call: Discovery recap + next steps

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and agreed next steps so we have alignment.

Notes from call:
- Use case: real-time risk scoring for transaction flows (~250 qps now, expect seasonal spikes up to ~600 qps)
- Latency target: p50 ~200ms, p95 under 600ms for production
- Security: must support SOC2 + VPC peering / Private deployment for production data
- Success criteria for pilot: validate p50/p95 under representative traffic and measure cost per 1M tokens (or per inference)

Agreed next steps:
1) Redwood: share a pricing ballpark and pilot proposal (I attached Pricing-Estimate-FintechX.xlsx)
2) Connor: prepare a short demo and a pilot runbook showing how we would validate latency at your scale
3) FinTechX: share traffic histograms and example request payloads (Tom)

Timeline: we tentatively targeted a pilot kickoff in early August, pending internal approvals.
I'll follow up in a week with the pricing ballpark and demo materials. Please let me know if I've missed anything.

Best,
Marissa Cole
